=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text minus "-"
text tsteps "steps until the ant leaves the grid: "
text tbox "black cells, rows and columns "
text tto ".."
text tdot "."
text thash "#"
global grid uchar 10000
global box ulong 4
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note the ant starts at (50, 50) of a white 100 x 100 grid facing up; on white it turns right, on black
note left, then flips the cell and steps forward; directions 0..3 are up, right, down, left
fn walk to ulong
r = long 50
c = long 50
d = ulong 0
s = ulong 0
note the ant is known to leave a grid this size after about 12000 steps (the highway starts near
note step 10000), so 999999 is a safe bound
while and and ge r 0 lt r 100 and ge c 0 lt c 100 bound 999999
k = add mul ulong r 100 ulong c
if eq get grid k 0
d = rem add d 1 4
put grid k 1
else
d = rem add d 3 4
put grid k 0
end
r = add r dy d
c = add c dx d
s = add s 1
end
ret s
end
fn dy d ulong to long
if eq d 0
ret -1
end
if eq d 2
ret 1
end
ret 0
end
fn dx d ulong to long
if eq d 1
ret 1
end
if eq d 3
ret -1
end
ret 0
end
note bounds finds the smallest box holding every black cell: box = top, bottom, left, right
fn bounds to void
put box 0 99
put box 1 0
put box 2 99
put box 3 0
for r ulong 100
for c ulong 100
if eq get grid add mul r 100 c 1
grow r c
end
end
end
end
fn grow r ulong c ulong to void
if lt r get box 0
put box 0 r
end
if gt r get box 1
put box 1 r
end
if lt c get box 2
put box 2 c
end
if gt c get box 3
put box 3 c
end
end
note row prints grid row r between the box's left and right columns
fn row r ulong to void
for x ulong add sub get box 3 get box 2 1
c = add x get box 2
if eq get grid add mul r 100 c 1
emit thash
else
emit tdot
end
end
emit nl
end
fn main to int
emit tsteps
emitu walk
emit nl
bounds
emit tbox
emitu get box 0
emit tto
emitu get box 1
emit sp
emitu get box 2
emit tto
emitu get box 3
emit nl
for r ulong add sub get box 1 get box 0 1
row add r get box 0
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
